description: CMSF-00 extends [MSF], which its references cite as draft-ietf-moq-warp-01 (WARP Streaming Format, 22 July 2025) - a draft that predates MSF-00 and that this corpus does not carry, so no `requires` is named. Its catalog example writes version as a Number and puts each track's header in initData; these vectors cover only what CMSF-00 itself defines.
